description: This Dart source file defines an API client class (`ApiClient`) that provides methods to perform HTTP GET and POST requests, as well as fetching raw HTML content. The class uses `HttpClient` for network requests and supports dynamic base URLs through external configuration. It is designed for use in a Flutter or Dart-based project to facilitate API interactions.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing HTTP methods (`get`, `postJson`, `getRawHtml`) to communicate with backend APIs with support for dynamic base URL management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path, with optional query parameters and settings override. Parses JSON responses or returns plain text.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Sends a JSON payload via HTTP POST to the specified path, optionally with settings override. Expects JSON response.

methods.name: getRawHtml
methods.description: Fetches raw HTML content as a string from the specified path, with optional query parameters and settings override.
